stock.description: Noble Engineering Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides wet trade work services in Hong Kong. The company undertakes tile and brick laying, plastering, floor screeding, and marble works. It offers its wet trade services for various building construction projects, including residential, community facility, public housing, and commercial development projects in the private and public sectors. The company was formerly known as Noble Engineering Holdings Limited and changed its name to Noble Engineering Group Holdings Limited in August 2017. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Cheung Sha Wan, Hong Kong.
